policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Roosevelt draw again and remain the division's longest unbeaten side Roosevelt's draw with Northern Michigan leaves their record still clear of a defeat, and no other unbeaten programme in the division has played as many matches. North Georgia, in the Peach Belt, are the next longest to have gone without losing.
